$comment: Generated by scripts/conformance/build.ts. One entry per widget of corpus/conformance/{auto,visual}; checks[].native = what plain browser engines answer (a sanity reference for the test, not the expectation: out-of-profile and sandbox-only checks differ by design).

external.limit.cpu: corpus/attacks and tests/lifecycle.spec.ts: CPU quota, deferral, kill

tests.title: HTML elements and their UA styles: text, headings, sections, lists, tables, ruby, legacy, unknown, details, button, links, gauges

checks.name: i, em, cite, dfn, var are italic
u, ins underline; s, del strike
rt is drawn above the base
it renders as an inert span: its type selector does not match
closed details is only as tall as its summary
summary is a list item (disclosure marker)
button has a box with padding
button has a visible background or border
a[href=#…] is a link (UA link colour, underline)
an external href never reaches the renderer (a[href^=https] does not match)
it is still drawn as a link

tests.title: Global attributes, dir, data-/aria-, legacy presentational attributes, inline handlers, out-of-profile attributes; formats, remote images

checks.name: BMP is refused (placeholder, not the 2px image)
ICO is refused (placeholder, not the 2px image)
a remote image becomes the 48px placeholder
dir=rtl lays out inline boxes right to left
dir=auto with Hebrew text resolves to rtl
contenteditable does not reach the renderer
draggable does not reach the renderer
tabindex does not reach the renderer

tests.title: Layout and box model: display, flex, gap, grid, table, sizes, spacing, positioning, overflow

checks.name: a block fills the container width
inline-block keeps its width on the line
row places children side by side
flex-wrap moves the third item to a new line
auto-placement wraps to the next row
table cells side by side, the second takes the rest
display: contents children join the flex row
width: fit-content shrinks to the text
negative margin pulls the box up
aspect-ratio: 2 makes a 60px wide box 30px high
margin-inline-start in RTL is a right margin
outline does not change the box
float:right sits at the right edge
column-count: 2 puts the third block in column two
absolute: left/top inside a relative parent
right/bottom anchor to the far edges
fixed is placed against the bubble
the higher z-index is on top
overflow: auto is neutralised to hidden
visibility: hidden is skipped by hit testing
a hidden box keeps its size

tests.title: Units, viewport units, calc/min/max/clamp, custom properties, CSS-wide keywords, generated content, env()

checks.name: display: revert is the UA block
env() resolves to its fallback or is dropped

tests.title: Colours, colour functions, light-dark(), backgrounds and data: images, gradients, box-shadow, outline, object-fit

checks.name: a remote url() never reaches the renderer

tests.title: Fonts (generic families, named families and @font-face out), font properties, tabular numbers, alignment, decoration, transforms, white-space, wrapping, ellipsis, line clamp, text-shadow, vertical-align, lists, writing-mode, RTL and shaping, emoji, selection

checks.name: monospace: i and M have the same advance
computed font-family keeps the generic name
ui-monospace: i and M have the same advance
serif and sans-serif are different faces
a named family is dropped: "Courier New" alone is not monospace
a named family is dropped from the list ("Times New Roman", sans-serif → sans-serif)
@font-face is dropped: the fallback monospace is used
text-align: end in RTL is the left edge
pre-line keeps the newline, collapses the spaces
overflow-wrap: anywhere breaks a long word
word-break: break-all breaks a long word
list-style-position: inside moves the text right
Hebrew in dir=rtl starts at the right edge
Arabic lam-alef is shaped (ligature narrower than its letters)

tests.title: Selectors: type, class, id, attributes, combinators, structural pseudo-classes, :is/:where, :has, :root, pseudo-elements, :hover kept, :focus and host-scoped selectors out

checks.name: :hover rules are kept and do not match without a pointer
:focus never matches (no keyboard focus in v1)
:scope at the top level matches nothing
a class added from script restyles

tests.title: @media (width, colour scheme, reduced motion, hover/pointer, print), @supports from the profile, @import, @container, @layer, @property, exotic at-rules, CSS nesting

checks.name: @media and matchMedia agree on reduced motion
@supports (3D transform) is false: 3D is out of the profile
a later @layer wins regardless of source order

tests.title: 2D transforms, 3D transforms out, filter (blur, brightness, drop-shadow; others; url() out), backdrop-filter, blend modes, clip-path, mask, opacity, pointer-events, touch-action, cursor

checks.name: rotateY(60deg) is dropped: the box keeps its width

stages.name: transform-3d
stages.xfail: the validator does not strip 3D transforms yet

stages.name: filter-url
stages.xfail: the validator does not enforce the profile yet

tests.title: CSS animations (@keyframes, timing, direction, iteration, fill-mode, play-state), transitions (incl. negative delay), steps() easing, animation and transition events

checks.name: animation events carry animationName and elapsedTime
a paused animation at -2.5s of 10s is at 25%
steps(4, end) at 37.5% is the first step
a transition with a negative delay starts part-way

tests.title: Web Animations: Element.animate, pause and seek, keyframe offsets and easing, getAnimations, finished, cancel, timeline; control of CSS animations through getAnimations (needs the webAnimations feature, D5)

checks.name: the renderer applies the seeked frame (computed transform)
document.getAnimations() lists script and CSS animations
a seek is visible to a layout query in the same task
a CSS animation shows up in getAnimations()
pause() + currentTime seek a CSS animation
the renderer shows the seeked CSS frame
a seeked width animation lays out in a later task

tests.title: Canvas 2D: rectangles, paths, line styles, gradients (conic is a candidate), patterns, transforms, clipping, text and measureText, alpha, compositing, shadows, ctx.filter, Path2D, drawImage, ImageData, hit testing, HiDPI backing store; WebGL and read-back out

checks.name: the backing store keeps its width attribute
toDataURL does not hand pixels back

tests.title: Inline SVG: shapes with presentation attributes, g/use/symbol/viewBox, text, gradients, CSS on SVG, clipPath/mask, filters, SMIL, <image>, foreignObject out; SVG geometry queries

checks.name: a stylesheet fill reaches SVG (computed fill)

tests.title: DOM building, queries, CSSOM, events; layout queries answered by the renderer: rects, boxes, computed style (incl. shorthands), matchMedia, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver, elementFromPoint, measureText

checks.name: insertAdjacentHTML is parsed in the sandbox and rendered
a removed node has no box
capture, target, bubble order and detail
getClientRects of a wrapped inline gives one rect per line
measureText agrees with DOM text width

tests.title: Timers, frames, microtasks, storage (16 KB quota), Intl, locale, crypto, built-ins, eval, CSS.supports from the profile, visibility, bundled libraries; network, navigation, dialogs, device APIs, shadow DOM, blobs, fullscreen out

checks.name: timeouts fire in delay order, after microtasks
requestAnimationFrame: three frames with increasing timestamps
setItem / getItem / property access / length / key
over 16 KB per message: setItem throws QuotaExceededError
XHR, WebSocket, EventSource, RTCPeerConnection, Worker, sendBeacon, importScripts throw NetworkDisabledError
confirm → false, prompt → null, alert does not block
no geolocation or media devices; vibrate is false

tests.title: TelegramWidget SDK (ready, theme, themeParams, openLink with a gesture, openTelegramLink, haptics, profile, no sendMessage); taps: click, pointer and mouse events, :active, details toggle, links; dblclick; context menu, keyboard and wheel out
tests.hint: Tap every button from top to bottom, then double-tap “dbl”, long-press or right-click “ctx”, press a key, scroll over “wheel”, tap Finish.

host.name: openLink from a tap reaches the host once
openLink from a timer is blocked
tapping an external <a href> goes to openLink
preventDefault on a link tap: no openLink

checks.name: click on the tapped element with coordinates inside it
pointerdown → pointerup → click, primary pointer with an id and type
openLink is callable in the task of a tap
an external link tap reaches the widget as a click
preventDefault on a link click is honoured
tapping a #fragment link does not leave the widget
no contextmenu event reaches the widget
no wheel event reaches the widget
theme is "light" or "dark" and onTheme calls back at once
sendMessage is not in the SDK

tests.title: Drag (pointer events with capture), hover events and :hover (desktop pointers), pointer-events: none, touch events on touch clients, no text selection
tests.hint: Hover “hover”, drag the knob to the right end, drag it again past the track, tap the striped overlay, drag across the stage text, tap Finish.

checks.name: pointerenter, pointerover, mouseenter reach the widget
pointerdown → pointermove (buttons=1) → pointerup moves the knob
setPointerCapture keeps moves coming past the element
movementX adds up to the distance
a tap through a pointer-events: none overlay hits the button below

stages.name: no-selection
stages.xfail: the client does not disable selection yet (D18)

tests.title: Elements out of the profile: form controls, dialog and popover (top layer), media, embedded content, MathML; they must be neutralised the same way everywhere

checks.name: form submission never navigates (submit reaches the widget)
:checked does not match (the control is gone)
showModal does not put the dialog in the top layer (:modal never matches)
a shown dialog stays where the widget put it
showPopover does not open a top-layer popover
a popover stays inside the widget

tests.title: Strict limits: 64 KB text values, the complex-script budget, the 256-timer cap, budgets over data-* attributes, attr() under strict

checks.name: a text node over 64 KB is refused
past 8192 complex-script units in the document the text is refused
a 300 KB data-* attribute does not reach the renderer
attr() of a text attribute (data-*) works
attr() of a non-text attribute (class) is dropped

tests.title: What the client does around the widget: live theme switch, off-screen pause (no frames, timers at 1 Hz, visibilitychange), auto height with a hard clip at the cap
tests.hint: Switch the chat to dark and back, scroll the bubble off screen for two seconds and back, tap Grow.

host.name: the bubble grows with the widget and is clipped at the cap (900px)

checks.name: switching to dark: onTheme, matchMedia, @media and light-dark() follow
switching back to light: all four follow again
timers run at most once per second while hidden

tests.title: No keyboard (D4): key events never reach the widget, Enter/Space do not activate buttons or links, focus() does not take the focus from the chat input, a key press is not a user gesture for the bridge
tests.hint: Type in the chat input field: the widget must not steal the focus. Tap “button”, press Enter, Space and A; tap “link”, press Enter; tap Finish.

host.name: focus() from the widget leaves the chat input focused
a key press does not unlock openLink
host.xfail: a keydown still counts as a user gesture

checks.name: no keydown, keyup, keypress, beforeinput or input event reaches the widget
Enter and Space add no clicks to a tapped button or link (one click each)
focus() does not make :focus match in the renderer

tests.title: Boxes: borders, radius, shadows, outline, opacity, overflow clipping
tests.hint: Each live box (left) should look like the reference picture (right).

tests.title: Colours and gradients: linear, radial, conic (candidate), colour functions (candidates), background images
tests.hint: Each live box (left) should look like the reference picture (right).

tests.title: Text: system font families, weights, decoration, alignment, ellipsis and line clamp (candidates), RTL and Arabic shaping, emoji, text-shadow (candidate)
tests.hint: Fonts differ between platforms: compare the structure (which line is bold, where text breaks, what is underlined), not the exact letter shapes.

tests.title: Layout: flex with gap, grid (candidate), table, positioning and z-index, float and multi-column (candidate)
tests.hint: Each live box (left) should look like the reference picture (right).

tests.title: 2D transforms; 3D transforms out (must look flat); filter blur, brightness, drop-shadow; other filters, backdrop-filter, blend, clip-path, mask (candidates or conditional)
tests.hint: Each live box (left) should look like the reference picture (right). The 3D row must look flat.

tests.title: CSS animations and transitions, live: slide, spin, pulse, steps, a frozen frame, a transition on tap
tests.hint: Moving rows: the box should move as the caption says (the picture shows the frames it moves between). Frozen row: must match exactly. Tap the last box once.

tests.title: Web Animations (element.animate, pause and seek, keyframe offsets, control of CSS animations)
tests.hint: Top row moves; the other rows are frozen by script and must match the picture exactly. Tap the bouncing ball to stop it half-way.

tests.title: Canvas 2D drawing: shapes and paths, line styles, gradients and patterns, text, transforms and clipping, alpha; shadows, ctx.filter and conic gradients (candidates); a chart
tests.hint: Each live canvas (left) should look like the reference picture (right).

tests.title: Inline SVG: shapes, structure and viewBox, gradients, text; CSS on SVG, clipPath/mask, filters, SMIL (candidates)
tests.hint: Each live picture (left) should look like the reference (right). The last row moves.

tests.title: Images: data: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP; SVG images (candidate); BMP/ICO and remote URLs out (placeholder); object-fit; background images
tests.hint: Each live row (left) should look like the reference (right).

tests.title: Taps, pressed state, details, drag, hover (desktop), link opening with confirmation
tests.hint: Do what each row says; the widget shows ✓ when it saw the input.

tests.title: Theme: light-dark(), prefers-color-scheme and onTheme follow the chat theme live; --tg-theme-* palette (not implemented yet)
tests.hint: Switch the chat between light and dark: the live box must match the picture for the current theme.

tests.title: Out of the profile, neutralised the same way everywhere: form controls, inner scrolling, sticky, named fonts, 3D, popover over the chat
tests.hint: Each live box (left) must look like the reference (right): the out-of-profile feature is simply not there. Tap “Show popover”: nothing may appear outside this bubble.
